text:
marina: Heads up — follow-ups from yesterday's prod OOM on prod-shard-7. I sketched a remediation roster and quick experiments; want owners + deadlines so we can roll canaries next week.
sandeep: Can you paste the postmortem link and ticket IDs? I'll sync with infra.
marina: Postmortem and initial RCA here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6543. Incident INC-4219. Short summary: recurring KV growth + slot fragmentation during high-concurrency GC windows.
julia: For profiling, I can run an allocation sampling + fragmentation diff on canary. Plan: heap-sample @ 100ms for 5m during ramp. Tool: heap-profiler v2. Example: ```heap-profiler --target prod-shard-7 --duration 300 --sample-ms 100 --out /tmp/heap-prod7.pb```.
dario: I can own the eviction-probe experiment: add small per-shard eviction threshold and measure hit-rate/latent reclaims. Proposed config change (non-disruptive): ```shard.eviction_threshold = 0.85  # start conservative```. Will run as a staged flag rollout.
kevin: GC tuning note: we saw jemalloc background purges spike CPU then fragmentation. Suggested JVM/allocator knobs + a short lived purge window after low-traffic periods. I'll prepare a canary script to adjust purge_interval and measure RSS reduction.
marina: Great. Let's map owners/times: Sandeep -> infra limits / max-resident cap + alert (due Thu EOD). Julia -> fragmentation diff and heap profiles (due Fri 3pm). Dario -> eviction-probe flag + staged rollout (prototype by Mon, canary Tue). Kevin -> GC/purge tuning canary (run Wed), validate perf. I'll coordinate rollback playbook and runbook updates.
sandeep: Confirmed. I'll also add an automated telemetry check for sudden KV size deltas > 20% over 10m and open ENG-6601 for alerting.
julia: Adding tests: I'll include a synthetic churn job that reproduces slot fragmentation locally and capture before/after diffs; will put artifacts in the ticket.
dario: For the probe, I'll log these metrics: eviction_rate, reclaimed_bytes, eviction_latency_ms. If we see >10% reclaim with <5ms latency, we promote flag.
kevin: For canary, recommend traffic split: 2% -> 10% -> 50% with 1h soak at each step and automated rollback on OOM or >5% latency regressions. ops-bot: canary-rollout created ENG-6620 by marina.
marina: Ops, please add the canary schedule to the calendar: Friday 10:00 PT for sync + first greenlight. We'll do an async update if anything slips. :calendar: :eyes:
sandeep: I'll also schedule a cross-team retro next Wed to discuss recurring patterns and whether service-level admission control is needed.
julia: Quick note — when you run heap-profiler, collect both active allocation stacks and arena fragmentation maps. Fragmentation map example output: `frag_pct: 23.4; free_runs: 412; largest_free: 24MB`.
dario: Also adding a small safety limit: if reclaimed_bytes < 1MB over 30m and KV growth > 10% we'll throttle ingest. I'll implement as rate-limiter feature flag.
kevin: I'll coordinate with SRE to capture perf counters during the canary: page-faults, RSS, swap-ins, and jemalloc stats.
marina: Excellent. Owners recap in one line: Sandeep (limits+alerts, ENG-6601) ; Julia (profiling+frag diffs, attach to ENG-6543) ; Dario (eviction probe + limits, ENG-6622) ; Kevin (GC tuning canary, ENG-6623). Deadlines: Sandeep Thu EOD, Julia Fri 3pm, Dario Mon prototype / Tue canary, Kevin Wed canary.
marina: I'll follow up with a short checklist in the ticket and mark this thread as the canonical action tracker. Ping me for blockers. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for prod-shard-7 on 1940127000. Rollout policy: auto-rollback on OOM.
kevin: One more — we should capture a baseline memory profile snapshot now so we can compare post-tuning. I'll drop a snapshot command in ENG-6543.
marina: Thanks everyone. Quick async check-in Friday after Julia's profiling is fine. If any blocker, call it out here and we'll grab the war-room. :phone:
